name: Regular City Council Meeting
agenda_text:
Regular City Council Meeting
CONSOLIDATED AGENDA
August 14, 2012
05:30 P.M.
CALL TO ORDER - City Council Chambers, 200 Civic Center Drive, Vista, California
ROLL CALL
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE AND INVOCATION - Reverend Michael Carr, All Saints Episcopal Church
BROWN ACT NOTICE OF SIMULTANEOUS MEETING COMPENSATION
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
CLOSED SESSION
CS.
Reports on action taken in Closed Session
PRESENTATIONS
P1.
People’s Choice Award to Malsu Lee for the Visions 2012 Art Exhibit.
P2.
Proclamation declaring Wednesday, August 15, 2012, "Peggy Zachary Day" in the City of Vista.
P3.
Certificate of Appointment to Lisa Sikes to serve on the Parks & Recreation Commission.
CONSENT CALENDAR
C1.
Check Register (CC)
C2.
Approval of Minutes (CC/CDC/SA/BSD)
C3.
Treasurer’s Cash Report for Month Ending May 31, 2012 (CC)
C4.
2012 League Conference Voting Delegate and Alternates (CC)
C5.
Approval of FPPC Form 806 - Agency Report of Public Official Appointments (CC/BSD)
C6.
As Needed Agreements for Environmental and CEQA/NEPA Services (CC)
1.
City Council Resolution No. 2012- , approving an as-needed agreement with Dudek for environmental consulting services; and
2.
City Council Resolution No. 2012- , approving an as-needed agreement with Atkins North America, Inc., for CEQA/NEPA consulting services.
C7.
Approval of the First Amendment to the Joint Exercise of Powers Agreement Creating the Southern California Intergovernmental Training and Development Center (CC)
C8.
Vista Village Drive Overcrossing Median Landscape - Award of Contract (CC)
C9.
Appointments by Outside Agencies to Fill Unscheduled Vacancies on Various Commissions and Boards (CC)
1.
JoAnn Jones, Vista Unified School District's (VUSD) representative, to fill the unscheduled vacancy on the Parks and Recreation Commission.
2.
Angela Chunka, VUSD's representative, to fill the unscheduled vacancy on the Public Arts Commission.
3.
Teri Sowell, Friends of the Rancho Buena Vista Adobe Foundation's representative, to fill the unscheduled vacancy on the Public Arts Commission.
4.
Leroy Tardy, Vista Village Business Association's (VVBA) representative, to fill the unscheduled vacancy on the Central Vista Business Improvement District Advisory Board (CVBID).
5.
Maureen Barrack, VVBA's representative, to fill the unscheduled vacancy on the Public Arts Commission.
C10.
Public Arts Commission "Kites Over Vista" Approval (CC)
C11.
Use and Commitment Agreement for Unencumbered Housing Bond Funds (CDC/SA)
1.
Adopt Successor Agency Resolution No. 2012- , approving a Use and Commitment Agreement with the Housing Authority of the City of Vista; and
2.
Adopt Community Development Commission Resolution No. 2012- , operating as the Housing Authority of the City of Vista, approving a Use and Commitment Agreement with the Successor Agency for the Vista Redevelopment Agency. ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR FOR DISCUSSION
DISCUSSION
D1.
Third Recognized Obligation Payment Schedule and Administrative Budget (SA)
1.
Successor Agency Resolution No. 2012- , approving a Third Recognized Obligation Payment Schedule; and
2.
Adopt Successor Agency Resolution No. 2012- , approving the third Administrative Budget.
PUBLIC HEARING
PH1.
Vista Business Park Specific Plan Amendment and Rezone (CC)
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
REMARKS
R1.
Reports from members of the governing bodies on outside committee meetings.
R2.
Reports and comments from City officials and members of the governing bodies.
ADJOURNMENT
